tip.en: Heart rate hit 100 bpm in under 50 seconds — dramatically faster cardiac recruitment than your recent Auckland and Melbourne easy runs where avg HR was 107–119. Your body is working hard from the gun here; this isn't a warm-up pace.
tip.zh: 不到50秒心率就已达到100次/分——比你近期奥克兰和墨尔本轻松跑（平均心率107-119）的心脏激活速度快得多。从起跑开始你的身体就已全力工作，这根本不是热身配速。

tip.en: A sharp 13.8% grade over just 20–30 metres while HR was still climbing through the 120s — this early incline cost you cardiac headroom before you'd found your rhythm. HR jumped from 122 to 125 across this bump alone.
tip.zh: 仅20-30米的13.8%坡度，此时心率仍在120多次/分上升阶段——这段早期坡道在你找到节奏之前就消耗了你的心率余量，仅这段起伏心率就从122跳升到125。

tip.en: Pace spikes to 16:20 and stays erratic for ~10 seconds (idx 360–366), suggesting a road crossing or signal wait. HR held steady at 143 — a small passive recovery before the flat middle section.
tip.zh: 配速飙升至16:20并在约10秒内持续不稳定（idx 360-366），这说明可能在过马路或等红绿灯。心率稳定在143次/分——进入中段平坦路前的小幅被动恢复。

tip.en: At km 1.3 on completely flat terrain (grade 0%) HR crosses 145 bpm — 3 bpm above your avg HR for the whole run. Compare this with 官渠公园 where avg HR was 140 over similar flat distance; today's cardiac cost is elevated from the first kilometre.
tip.zh: 在1.3公里完全平坦路段（坡度0%），心率超过145次/分——比全程平均心率高3次/分。对比官渠公园同样平坦距离平均心率140的表现，今天从第一公里开始心脏负荷就更高。

tip.en: HR had sat in the 143–145 band for nearly 400 metres, then at idx 522 it starts climbing again — 146, 147 — on still-flat ground. This drift upward without a grade change signals genuine cardiovascular strain; your 宝山 run showed a similar pattern at avg 138 but on a harder course.
tip.zh: 心率在143-145区间维持了近400米后，在idx 522处无任何坡度变化的情况下再次开始攀升——146、147。这种无坡度变化的心率漂移信号表明你正承受真实的心血管压力；你的宝山那次跑平均138次/分，但赛道更难。

title.en: HR 148 as the Route Begins Undulating
title.zh: 路线开始起伏时心率达148

tip.en: Around km 2.0 the terrain starts a series of small rolling grades (0.8–0.9%) and HR jumps to 148–149, your highest so far. You're entering the most topographically complex section of the run with little cardiac reserve left.
tip.zh: 约2.0公里处地形开始出现一系列小幅起伏（0.8-0.9%坡度），心率跳升至148-149次/分，这是目前为止的最高值。你正以极少的心率余量进入全程地形最复杂的路段。

title.zh: 起伏路段中段配速跌至7:52

tip.en: At km 2.2 pace drops sharply to 7:52 — nearly a minute per km slower than your average — while HR falls slightly to 143–144. This looks like a deliberate check-in or a momentary stumble; worth noting it happened before the steepest descent of the loop.
tip.zh: 在2.2公里处配速急剧下降至7:52——比平均配速慢将近每公里1分钟——同时心率小幅回落至143-144次/分。这看起来像是有意识地自我检视，或是短暂的踉跄；值得注意的是这发生在全程最陡下坡之前。

tip.en: The steepest downhill in the run (-11.6% at idx 831-832) arrives while HR is already 145. Despite gravity assistance, pace only reaches ~6:08 here — braking effort is high, and quad load on this sharp descent is significant for a short run.
tip.zh: 全程最陡下坡（idx 831-832，-11.6%）出现时心率已达145次/分。尽管有重力辅助，配速在此仅约6:08——制动消耗很大，对于一次短距离跑步而言，这段陡降对股四头肌的负荷相当可观。

title.en: Full Stop Near the Bridge at 2.9km

tip.en: Pace crawls from 5:50 to 7:39, then 11:25, 14:22, 18:07 over about 20 seconds (idx 962–970) — this is a near-complete stop. HR drops from 148 to 141 in that window. The route coordinates show you backtracked slightly; likely a road crossing or barrier. The subsequent restart took another 15+ seconds to resume normal pace.
tip.zh: 配速从5:50爬升至7:39，然后11:25、14:22、18:07，在约20秒内几近完全停步（idx 962-970）——心率在此期间从148降至141。路线坐标显示你略微折返；可能是遇到了路口或障碍物。随后重新启动又花了15秒以上才恢复正常配速。

title.en: Max Effort Burst — HR 151 on the Return Loop Ramp
title.zh: 返程坡道最大强度爆发——心率达151

tip.en: This is the same bridge/underpass ramp you descended at idx 68–90 on the outbound leg. Second time through, HR hits 151 — the highest value outside the final 500m — with grade reaching 11.3%. You're running this harder on fatigued legs than you did fresh.
tip.zh: 这正是去程idx 68-90时下坡的同一座桥/涵洞坡道。第二次经过时心率达到151次/分——除最后500米外的最高值——坡度达到11.3%。你在疲惫的双腿上比去程时跑得更用力。

title.zh: 第二次交通停顿打断节奏

tip.en: Pace spikes to 11:54 and lingers above 10 min/km for about 20 seconds (idx 1232–1250), HR falls from 151 to 144. This is your second significant involuntary stop and it comes right after the hardest climb of the return leg — recovery stolen by red lights, not earned.
tip.zh: 配速飙升至11:54，在约20秒内持续高于10分钟/公里（idx 1232-1250），心率从151降至144。这是你第二次明显的非自愿停步，恰好发生在返程最难爬坡之后——被红灯偷走的恢复，不是自己挣来的。

title.en: HR Climbs Back to 152 — Final Effort Ramp
title.zh: 心率重回152——最后一段努力爬坡

tip.en: From km 4.3 onward HR climbs steadily from 151 to 156 over 400 metres of gentle +1–2% grade. This is the strongest sustained cardiac output of the entire run. The fact that you're still accelerating effort this late, after two stops and a full loop, speaks to good base fitness.
tip.zh: 从4.3公里开始，在400米+1-2%缓坡上心率稳步从151攀升至156次/分。这是全程持续时间最长的最强心脏输出。在两次停步和完整一圈之后，你在这么晚的阶段仍能持续加大努力，说明基础体能良好。

title.en: HR Peak 156 Matches Recent Hard Efforts
title.zh: 心率峰值156与近期高强度表现持平

tip.en: Max HR 156 is consistent with your 宝山 and 官渠 runs (both 157) but well below your all-time recent ceiling of 164. Today's loop on this near-flat course in Tianjin produced the same peak cardiac cost as runs with far more elevation — the flat-but-interrupted nature of this route is genuinely tiring.
tip.zh: 最高心率156与你宝山和官渠跑（均为157）相近，但远低于近期历史峰值164次/分。今天在天津这条几乎平坦的路线上，产生了与坡度大得多的跑步相同的心脏峰值负荷——这条平坦但多次中断的路线确实消耗体力。
